admission: Admit only complete directed stop patterns on explicitly mapped operator/line geometry. All source calls, branches, call rules and border termini retained. Every pair must pass projection, connectivity and detour checks. Historic official corridor inference, not certified street directions, current diversions or observed movement. Three individually pinned sub-metre topology connectors are inferred and reported per pair and trip; no other gap filling. Failed bus pairs may use complete exact-identity Luzern 2026 paths; successful original pairs are retained and every source switch is recorded at a scheduled stop. Zugerbergbahn uses exact federal installation and operating-point identities, retaining its full curve and reporting GTFS endpoint connectors. Explicitly reviewed bus pairs may use OSM road inference only after the official paths fail, with whole-pattern identity and all-context path consensus. Failed S26/RE6 Däniken–Schönenwerd and IR75 Kreuzlingen–Konstanz pairs may use four exact standard-gauge SBB graphical segments, with full source curves and measured endpoint attachments. Federal source failures and the Däniken gauge conflict remain recorded. Two exact boat route/agency identities may use their explicitly inventoried swissTLMRegio lake graphs. GTFS dock attachment is capped at 200 m, with no new graph links. Every path segment is split at every Vector25 shoreline intersection; outside-water intervals must lie wholly within 200 m of one actual endpoint dock and are disclosed. Other land crossings reject the complete trip. These generalized cartographic paths are not navigational shipping lanes.
scopeLimits: Annual membership is complete for the pinned national timetable and official canton polygon, not proof of unrepresented real-world services.
Friday/Sunday plus preceding-day carry-in do not establish seasonal, holiday or year-round coverage.
No-stop through traffic is outside this passenger-service inventory.

Geometry admission uses mapped Zug Buslinien, exact Luzern 2026 bus supplements, standard-gauge FOT infrastructure and the exact federal Zugerbergbahn installation. Unresolved boat/rail/bus patterns remain in the coverage denominator. Both lake services have explicitly attributed swissTLMRegio inference, with 2007 shoreline evidence and recorded dock-area discrepancies; remote land crossings remain excluded. Failed explicitly inventoried bus pairs may use separately attributed OSM road inference; these paths are not operator-verified. The separately attributed SBB graphical supplement covers two explicit rail corridors; foreign schematic records are excluded.
The WFS matches the archive within 1 mm but proves no 2026 alignment validity. No realtime.

topologyJoins.method: Three explicitly reviewed sub-metre source endpoint-to-vertex discontinuities on identical line labels. Short straight connectors are inferred geometry, not publisher linework. No automatic proximity joins.

rail.method: Exact operating-point number, standard gauge (mm1435) only, original declared topology. Every other scheduled operating point is blocked during each pair search. Paths are inferred infrastructure corridors; track assignment and 2026 validity remain unproven.

busSupplement.method: Preserve successful Zug pairs. A failed pair may use a complete path from the exact mapped Luzern 2026 operator/line. No midpoint source splice, graph union, gap repair, renamed line or changed tolerance.
